get_actuator_min_max: get the minimum and maximum control range for MuJoCo actuators in a physics model
get_site_world_pose: get the 4x4 homogeneous transform representing the world pose of a MuJoCo site entity
get_site_relative_pose: compute the pose of one MuJoCo site relative to another site's frame of reference
get_site_velocity: get the 6-dim translational and rotational velocity of a MuJoCo site in world or local frame
get_site_relative_velocity: compute the relative 6-dim velocity between two MuJoCo sites in world, site A, or site B frame
